# Implementation Plan - Add Seach-3 Icon to SvgIcons.h

## Overview
Add the SVG string content from `resources/seach-3.svg` to the global `SvgIcons::icons` map in `src/ui/SvgIcons.h`.
Entries for `"seach-3"`, `"seach_3"`, `"seach-3.svg"`, `"search-3"`, `"search_3"`, and `"search-3.svg"` will be registered to allow flexible lookup via `UiHelper::getIcon(...)`.

---

- `src/ui/SvgIcons.h`

## Build & Verification Steps

### Build Command
```bash
cmake -B build -G "Visual Studio 17 2022" -A x64
cmake --build build --config Debug
```

### Verification Steps
1. Verify `src/ui/SvgIcons.h` compiles cleanly.
2. Call `UiHelper::getIcon("seach-3")` or `UiHelper::getIcon("seach_3")` in C++ code to verify the icon renders without fallback placeholder.

- [x] Adds entries directly to the single `SvgIcons::icons` SSOT map.
- [x] Preserves vector SVG rendering contract without hardcoding bitmap graphics or text symbols.

- `SvgIcons::icons` is defined as `inline const QMap<QString, QString> icons` in `src/ui/SvgIcons.h`.
